title: Tam Thuc La So Envelope
description: Versioned JSON envelope for all Tam Thuc engine outputs. Every engine (he) emits exactly this shape. Interpretation layers read but never write ban/cach_cuc/lich_phap/co_truong_phai. See strategy 4.3.

envelope_version.description: Envelope contract version. Consumers must reject unknown major versions with typed error.

he.description: Which Tam Thuc system produced this chart.

datetime.description: Local datetime of the query (ISO8601, no Z assumed local to tz).

tz.description: IANA offset or numeric tz, e.g. +07:00

kinh_do.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. VN default ~106.7 for HCMC.

loai_cau_hoi.description: Question category for dung-than selection (optional at envelope level).

lich_phap.description: Full CORE calendar/ganzhi output and flags (see FR-CORE-005). Opaque here but must be stamped completely.

ban.description: Engine-specific plate data. Opaque at envelope level; typed readers per `he` value. Engines write; AI layer reads only.

cach_cuc.description: Detected patterns (cach cuc / khoa the). RULE or engine fills; must carry citations.

co_truong_phai.description: All school / flag choices that affected this chart. Sorted BTreeMap in Rust / sorted dict in Python for stable cache keys. Engines MUST stamp every flag used.
